issues.issue: The rules list water and drainage districts under natural resources/conservation. An irrigation district probably fits that better than utilities.

issues.on_page: Local Receipts -- WATER ASSESSMENTS AND NRD 67,368.27
issues.issue: Irrigation water assessments are levied on land, so special assessments may fit better. The line also mixes in NRD money (intergovernmental). It is already marked review.
This is an irrigation district, not a power or utility entity. Treating it as entirely business-type (not governmental cash basis) is a judgment call.
The year end is assumed. Irrigation districts often use a calendar year (2024-12-31 or 2025-12-31).
